project_type: Next.js 16 App Router full-stack monolith — public site + member portal + admin console, single Postgres database via Neon
build_system: Next.js 16.3.5 with App Router. Uses 'proxy.ts' instead of 'middleware.ts' (renamed convention in Next 16). No monorepo — single package.json at root.
test_framework: Vitest (unit, run with 'npm run test'); Playwright (E2E, 'npm run e2e'). Vitest mocks Prisma via vi.mock('@/lib/db'). E2E tests in e2e/ directory.
verification_instructions: 1. npm run typecheck  — zero TypeScript errors. 2. npm run build — zero build errors. 3. npm run test — all unit tests pass. 4. npm run lint — zero ESLint violations. Each FEAT coder runs these four in order and reports the result in 'findings'.
snapshot_or_generated_files: prisma/client is generated — run 'npx prisma generate' after any schema change. Run 'npx prisma migrate dev --name <name>' to create + apply a migration. Never edit files under node_modules/@prisma/client directly.
environment_constraints: DATABASE_URL and DIRECT_URL must be set (Neon pooled + direct connection strings). Without them, 'npm run build' succeeds but DB queries fail at runtime. RESEND_API_KEY is optional — without it emails print to console (intentional dev fallback). Do NOT run 'prisma migrate deploy' (production command); use 'prisma migrate dev' in the dev workflow. Windows filesystem — use forward slashes in import paths, not backslashes.
contribution_requirements: 1. No hex literals in component files — CSS variables (semantic tokens) only. 2. No cross-module table access — go through service functions. 3. All admin/exec actions require requireRole check. 4. Status never communicated by colour alone — always glyph + word. 5. Touch targets >= 44x44px. 6. Visible focus rings on all interactive elements. 7. src/proxy.ts gates /me and /admin — update authConfig for new role-based admin gate.
key_patterns: 1. Server components call service functions (src/lib/<domain>/queries.ts or admin.ts); pages never import db directly. 2. Server actions in co-located actions.ts files, always gated with requireMember() or requireRole(). 3. Forms use react-hook-form + Zod schema from src/lib/validation/<domain>.ts. 4. Shared query functions use React.cache() for deduplication within a request. 5. Toasts via Sonner (already in src/components/ui/sonner.tsx). 6. Auth via auth() from src/auth.ts; edge-safe authConfig in src/auth.config.ts. 7. Email via deliver() in src/lib/email.ts — add new email functions to that file. 8. Layout groups: (auth) for auth screens, (member) for /me/**, (public) for public routes, (admin) NEW for /admin/**. 9. UI primitives from src/components/ui/ (shadcn). 10. Member portal pieces (PageIntro, StatRow, StatTile, Well, Code) in src/components/member/pieces.tsx.
directory_structure: src/app/(auth)/ — auth flows (done). src/app/(member)/me/ — member portal (done). src/app/(public)/ — public routes (homepage done; events, gallery, opportunities, verify, about needed). src/app/(admin)/ — admin console (NEW, all needed). src/app/api/ — API routes (auth handler exists; attendance bulk, certificates pdf, gallery upload needed). src/lib/ — domain service modules. src/components/ — shared UI (ui/ = shadcn primitives, member/ = member-specific, admin/ = NEW). prisma/ — schema + migrations + seed. docs/design/screens/ — 16 self-contained HTML mockups to build against. .agents/tasks/ — plan and FEAT artifacts (never committed, never inside a git commit).
